hypothesis.title: Does the Slope of the US Yield Curve Predict Six-Month-Ahead US Equity Returns? A Predictive Regression with Overlap-Robust Inference
hypothesis.statement: A flatter or inverted 10y-3m Treasury spread predicts lower S&P 500 returns over the next 126 sessions.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The slope coefficient of the 126-session-ahead S&P 500 log return on the 10y-3m spread is zero.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The slope coefficient is positive (HAC one-sided p < 0.05 and circular-shift placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Overlapping-horizon predictive regression with Newey-West HAC errors and circular-shift placebo
hypothesis.metric_name: slope of 126d forward return on 10y-3m spread
